textbook_summary: High calcium may eliminate ST; low calcium T may be low or inverted.
limitations: Fixed amplitude/timing choices, not concentration calibration
Inversion applied before electrode projection; opposite aVR polarity retained
No automatic progression, arrhythmia or perfusion inference
